title: Expose the exact Maker-GTD filled-order shape mismatch
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Continue the failed Maker-GTD repair by adding bounded, field-level diagnostics that identify the exact predicate causing maker_gtd_paper_filled_order_shape_mismatch without changing any order, fill, strategy, accounting, or persistence decision.
inScope: Distinguish the locked-row identity check from the requested Filled-order transition check when both currently return maker_gtd_paper_filled_order_shape_mismatch.

For the requested Filled-order transition, report the exact names of every failed predicate covering requested status, fill timestamp, cancellation timestamp, execution source, and each immutable order field.

For mismatched CreatedAtUtc and ExpiresAtUtc fields, report current/requested round-trip UTC values, ticks, and PostgreSQL-equivalent microseconds; for mismatched price, size, or notional fields, report current/requested invariant numeric values.
For mismatched RawDecisionJson, report SHA-256 fingerprints only; never log the full JSON through this diagnostic.
Propagate the diagnostic through MakerGtdPaperMutationResult and the existing Maker-GTD not-eligible warning while preserving the existing reason code.

Focused unit and PostgreSQL regression coverage, affected build, independent semantic review, context/history bookkeeping, approval checkpoint, implementation commit, and push to the deployment branch.
outOfScope: Any relaxation or change of Maker-GTD atomic validation, timestamp equivalence, execution semantics, strategy decisions, pricing, stake sizing, expiration, TouchNoDepth evidence, Paper/Live classification, or retry behavior.
Production deployment, restart, database mutation, schema migration, historical order repair, strategy/configuration mutation, or Live order action.
Market-data queue optimization, Historical Parity or Legacy backfill timeouts, WebSocket behavior, and log retention.
Logging full RawDecisionJson, secrets, credentials, or private keys.
scope.periodOrFilter: Maker-GTD Paper full-fill atomic transitions; Production evidence is the post-deploy order 0e05106d-e5b9-492d-a1b1-b19c634d2c03 observed from 2026-08-27T08:30:04.839Z through 2026-08-27T08:33:59.973Z.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the existing FilledOrderShapeMismatch dispatch paths and all predicates in IsValidFilledOrderTransition and SameImmutableOrderShape, then prove current logs contain no field-level detail for the exact Production order.

requirements.text: Continue diagnosis of the unresolved Maker-GTD filled-order shape mismatch without changing trading or persistence behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A FilledOrderShapeMismatch result identifies whether it came from locked-row identity drift or from the requested Filled-order transition.
Requested-transition diagnostics name every failed predicate using deterministic stable field names.
Timestamp diagnostics expose both exact values, ticks, and PostgreSQL-equivalent microseconds; numeric diagnostics expose both invariant values; RawDecisionJson exposes hashes only.
The existing maker_gtd_paper_filled_order_shape_mismatch reason code and every eligibility/atomicity decision remain unchanged.
No full RawDecisionJson, secret, credential, or private key is added to diagnostics.
No Production state is changed by this task.
